//@version=6
indicator("LuxQuant - Momentum Convergence Oscillator - micky v1.0", shorttitle="LuxQuant - Momentum Convergence Oscillator - micky v1.0", overlay=false)

// --- Groups & Constants ---
string G_MAIN    = "Main Settings"
string G_VISUAL  = "Visuals"
string G_DIV     = "Divergence Settings"
color  C_GREEN   = #089981
color  C_RED     = #f23645

// --- Inputs ---
int   lenRsiInput    = input.int(14, "RSI Length", minval=1, group=G_MAIN, tooltip="Length for the Momentum component.")
int   lenTrendInput  = input.int(24, "Trend Length", minval=1, group=G_MAIN, tooltip="Length for the Trend component.")
float trendMultInput = input.float(2.0, "Trend Sensitivity", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=G_MAIN, tooltip="Multiplies the trend component to balance it with momentum.")
int   smoothInput    = input.int(3, "Oscillator Smoothing", minval=1, group=G_MAIN, tooltip="Smooths the final oscillator line.")

bool  showSignals    = input.bool(true, "Show Alignment Signals", group=G_VISUAL, tooltip="Highlights the background when trend and momentum align.")
color bullColor      = input.color(C_GREEN, "Bullish Color", group=G_VISUAL, inline="Colors")
color bearColor      = input.color(C_RED, "Bearish Color", group=G_VISUAL, inline="Colors")
bool  colorBars      = input.bool(true, "Color Bars", group=G_VISUAL, tooltip="Colors the chart bars based on the oscillator state.")


bool showRegDiv    = input.bool(true, "Show Regular Divergence", group=G_DIV)
bool showHidDiv    = input.bool(false, "Show Hidden Divergence", group=G_DIV)
int divLookback    = input.int(5, "Pivot Lookback", minval=1, group=G_DIV)
color bullDivColor = input.color(C_GREEN, "Bullish Div Color", group=G_DIV, inline="Div Colors")
color bearDivColor = input.color(C_RED, "Bearish Div Color", group=G_DIV, inline="Div Colors")

// --- Calculations ---
// 1. Momentum Component (Normalized RSI)
float rsiValue = ta.rsi(close, lenRsiInput)
float mom      = rsiValue - 50 

// 2. Trend Component (Linear Regression Slope normalized)
float linreg      = ta.linreg(close, lenTrendInput, 0)
float linregPrev  = ta.linreg(close, lenTrendInput, 1)
float slope       = (linreg - linregPrev)
float atr         = ta.atr(lenTrendInput)
float trend       = (slope / (atr > 0 ? atr : 1.0)) * 100 * trendMultInput

// 3. Combined Oscillator
float rawOsc = mom + trend
float osc    = ta.ema(rawOsc, smoothInput)

// Essential for variable indexing/historical access in logic
max_bars_back(low, 500)
max_bars_back(high, 500)
max_bars_back(osc, 500)

// --- Logic ---
bool isBullish = osc > 0
bool isBearish = osc < 0

// Alignment Signals (Convergence)
bool bullAlign = trend > 0 and mom > 0
bool bearAlign = trend < 0 and mom < 0
bool bullSignal = bullAlign and not bullAlign[1]
bool bearSignal = bearAlign and not bearAlign[1]

// --- Divergence Logic (Persistent State) ---
float ph = ta.pivothigh(osc, divLookback, divLookback)
float pl = ta.pivotlow(osc, divLookback, divLookback)

var int   lastPlIdx = na
var float lastPlOsc = na
var float lastPlLow = na

var int   lastPhIdx = na
var float lastPhOsc = na
var float lastPhHigh = na

bool bullDiv    = false
bool bullHidDiv = false
bool bearDiv    = false
bool bearHidDiv = false

if not na(pl)
    if not na(lastPlIdx)
        if low[divLookback] < lastPlLow and osc[divLookback] > lastPlOsc
            bullDiv := true
        if low[divLookback] > lastPlLow and osc[divLookback] < lastPlOsc
            bullHidDiv := true
    lastPlIdx  := bar_index[divLookback]
    lastPlOsc  := osc[divLookback]
    lastPlLow  := low[divLookback]

if not na(ph)
    if not na(lastPhIdx)
        if high[divLookback] > lastPhHigh and osc[divLookback] < lastPhOsc
            bearDiv := true
        if high[divLookback] < lastPhHigh and osc[divLookback] > lastPhOsc
            bearHidDiv := true
    lastPhIdx  := bar_index[divLookback]
    lastPhOsc  := osc[divLookback]
    lastPhHigh := high[divLookback]

// --- Visuals ---
hline(0, "Zero Line", color=chart.fg_color, linestyle=hline.style_dashed)
plotColor = isBullish ? bullColor : bearColor
oscPlot   = plot(osc, "Oscillator", color=plotColor, linewidth=2)
zeroPlot  = plot(0, "Zero Reference", color=color.new(chart.fg_color, 100))

// Vertical Gradient Fills
fill(oscPlot, zeroPlot, top_value = math.max(0, osc), bottom_value = 0, top_color = color.new(bullColor, 50), bottom_color = color.new(bullColor, 100), title = "Bullish Fill")
fill(oscPlot, zeroPlot, top_value = 0, bottom_value = math.min(0, osc), top_color = color.new(bearColor, 100), bottom_color = color.new(bearColor, 50), title = "Bearish Fill")

// Highlights
bgcolor(showSignals and bullAlign ? color.new(bullColor, 90) : showSignals and bearAlign ? color.new(bearColor, 90) : na, title="Alignment Background")
hline(60, "OB Level", color=color.new(bearColor, 50), linestyle=hline.style_dotted)
hline(-60, "OS Level", color=color.new(bullColor, 50), linestyle=hline.style_dotted)

// Alignment Markers
plotshape(showSignals and bullSignal ? 0 : na, "Bullish Alignment", shape.circle, location.absolute, color=bullColor, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(showSignals and bearSignal ? 0 : na, "Bearish Alignment", shape.circle, location.absolute, color=bearColor, size=size.tiny)

// Divergence Visuals
plotshape(showRegDiv and bullDiv ? osc[divLookback] : na, "Regular Bullish Div", shape.labelup, location.absolute, bullDivColor, -divLookback, "Bull", color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(showRegDiv and bearDiv ? osc[divLookback] : na, "Regular Bearish Div", shape.labeldown, location.absolute, bearDivColor, -divLookback, "Bear", color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(showHidDiv and bullHidDiv ? osc[divLookback] : na, "Hidden Bullish Div", shape.labelup, location.absolute, bullDivColor, -divLookback, "H-Bull", color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(showHidDiv and bearHidDiv ? osc[divLookback] : na, "Hidden Bearish Div", shape.labeldown, location.absolute, bearDivColor, -divLookback, "H-Bear", color.white, size=size.tiny)

// Divergence Lines (on Oscillator)
if showRegDiv and bullDiv
    line.new(lastPlIdx, lastPlOsc, bar_index - divLookback, osc[divLookback], color=bullDivColor, width=2)
if showRegDiv and bearDiv
    line.new(lastPhIdx, lastPhOsc, bar_index - divLookback, osc[divLookback], color=bearDivColor, width=2)
if showHidDiv and bullHidDiv
    line.new(lastPlIdx, lastPlOsc, bar_index - divLookback, osc[divLookback], color=bullDivColor, width=1, style=line.style_dashed)
if showHidDiv and bearHidDiv
    line.new(lastPhIdx, lastPhOsc, bar_index - divLookback, osc[divLookback], color=bearDivColor, width=1, style=line.style_dashed)

// Bar Coloring
barcolor(colorBars ? (isBullish ? bullColor : bearColor) : na, title="Bar Color")


// --- Alerts ---
alertcondition(bullSignal, "Bullish Alignment", "Trend and Momentum aligned bullishly.")
alertcondition(bearSignal, "Bearish Alignment", "Trend and Momentum aligned bearishly.")
alertcondition(bullDiv, "Bullish Divergence", "Regular Bullish Divergence detected.")
alertcondition(bearDiv, "Bearish Divergence", "Regular Bearish Divergence detected.")
